basic_info.description:
Welcome to this charming home in the Portola neighborhood. It has been in one family since it was built. This wonderful home is your blank canvas with tons of potential to remodel/expand and make it your own. The backyard has many fruit trees such as apple, pear and plum.
The interior and exterior have been recently painted and hardwood floors refinished. The roof is newer and was installed in Aug. of 2022. 
It is in an excellent location with close proximity to HWY 101 and 280, shops and restaurants, public transportation, DT SF and approx. 10 miles from SFO.
